user.title: Set up WhatsApp
user.description: Enter the connection details for your WhatsApp API server.

data_description.base_url: Hostname or IP address of your WhatsApp API server (e.g. myserver.local or 192.168.1.100). https:// will be added automatically.
data_description.port: Port of your WhatsApp API server.
data_description.api_key: API key to authenticate against your WhatsApp API server.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WhatsApp
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for your WhatsApp API server.

data_description.base_url: Hostname or IP address of your WhatsApp API server. https:// will be added automatically.
data_description.port: Port of your WhatsApp API server.
data_description.api_key: API key to authenticate against your WhatsApp API server.

init.title: WhatsApp Options
init.description: Update the connection details for your WhatsApp API server.

data_description.base_url: Hostname or IP address of your WhatsApp API server. https:// will be added automatically.
